description: Use this when the user asks what photos, checklists, or list attachments are attached to an existing Familia task or plan. Use before editing an existing list attachment when the attachment id is unknown.

targetId.description: Task id when targetType is task, or plan item id when targetType is plan.

targetType.description: Type of Familia item that owns the attachments.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by the backend request.
